name: kimi-webbridge-dsh
description: Kimi WebBridge plugin for dsh: drive the user's real browser (their login sessions) through the local kimi-webbridge daemon at 127.0.0.1:10086. Registers a single kimi_webbridge tool covering navigate, click, fill, snapshot, screenshot, evaluate, cdp, network, upload, save_as_pdf, tab and session management.
